notes: Account summary: boutique financial research platform serving buy-side analysts and sell-side research subscribers. Heavy RAG/search focus for internal research portal and customer-facing knowledge search.

Primary ask: embeddings + reranking at large scale. Expectation: index ~50M documents (mix of filings, research notes, transcripts) resulting in ~200-400M vectors after chunking. Need predictable query economics and sub-200ms end-to-end for search+rerank for interactive UX.
Preferred deployment: Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) inside VPC with KMS integration and EU/NA residency controls. On-prem eval considered for particularly sensitive data islands.

Latency/throughput targets: median p95 retrieval+rerank <200ms for single-query path, peak throughput 200 qps with burst to 1k qps for end-of-day research spikes. Cost sensitivity: aiming for <$0.05 per query average across mixed workloads.

Model preferences: open model family (Llama 2 / Mistral variants) for reranker and 1536d embeddings for vector store. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization and mixed-precision to lower unit cost.

Indexing requirements: incremental sync from internal CMS (Kafka stream), deduping pipeline, retention rules (7 years for certain filings). Need connector guidance and tooling for incremental vector updates and TTL handling.

Security notes: strict data residency (EU for EU customers), require KMS/HSM-backed key control, audit logs forwarded to Splunk, SSO via SAML with SCIM provisioning. SOC2 evidence required before go-live.

POC status: POC started 2026-01-30. Sample corpus (1.2M docs) indexed to Redwood Dedicated trial; initial benchmark: 95ms median retrieval, 180ms p95 with lightweight reranker on quantized runtime (internal test). Team impressed with throughput; want full-scale cost estimate.
